messages:
maria: Quick sync for the launch + webinar SEO play. want a compact ops runbook that covers KW clustering, JSON-LD, micro-sitemaps, hreflang, internal link equity, and a careful redirect phasing plan. goal: maximize benchmark SERP presence and keep redirects zero-surprise. who takes what?

sam: Ill own keyword clusters & content briefs. plan: 4 clusters (benchmarks, cost calc, demo intent, enterprise controls). will produce a micro-sitemap mapping and meta/title variants for A/B. dropping a seed CSV tonight.

jake: Ill take schema + structured-data QA. will create Event + FAQPage + Speakership JSON-LD snippets and a sample include for Next. also adding a canonical-preference header note for SSR pages.

olivia: Ill do internal linking, redirect phasing, and sitemap shard updates. propose two-phase redirect roll: stage -> soft-announce -> live. will detect redirect chains and alias collisions.

anita: UTMs & routing: Ill standardize utm_campaign=serp_launch_3702, utm_content=variantA etc., and add hidden campaign_id for SFDC. will validate GTM/dataLayer event 'webinarSignup' prelaunch.

seo-ci-bot: CI queued: redirect-chain-scan + schema-lint. To trigger, upload redirect CSV to /marketing/seo/redirects/launch-3702461357.csv and schema partial to /marketing/seo/schema/launch-3702461357.jsonld

sam: uploaded seed: https://drive.redwood/seo/kw-seed-3702461357.csv  includes intent tags, suggested H1/H2s, two title variants, CTA mapping, and locale hints for hreflang. DEMO rows flagged.

jake: Example JSON-LD for webinar (draft):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Benchmarking Inference Costs","startDate":"2026-10-06T17:00:00Z","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},"location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/370246"}}
```
Will add FAQPage entries and speakership @ids in the include.

olivia: Redirect phasing (proposal):
1) stage CSV apply to staging proxy, run chain detector & link equity diff, smoke test.
2) soft-announce: set short 307 alias for campaign pages for 48h so affiliates use campaign link.
3) full cutover: replace aliases with final 301s, purge edge cache, update sitemap shards, submit index via GSC Indexing API for moved URLs.
Smoke test command: `curl -I -L -o /dev/null -w "%{url_effective} %{http_code} %{redirect_count}" https://redwood.ai/old-benchmark`

maria: Love the phased plan. Rules: prefer single-hop 301s for permanent moves, 307 for tracking shortlinks only, avoid mapping many old posts to homepage unless absolutely no match. if >5 external backlink sources to retired URL, escalate to salesops for inbound-routing mapping.

anita: SFDC mapping: campaign=SERP_LAUNCH_3702, content=fragment_id; I will create a validation sheet and run a test webhook to staging SFDC sandbox once forms wired. Also adding a fallback GTM event for direct GTM->SFDC payload if form fails.

sam: micro-sitemaps: Im producing per-cluster sitemaps (shard per 250 URLs) to speed reindexing. will include <changefreq> and <priority> hints and submit shards post-cutover.

jake: Schema QA checklist: 1) JSON-LD validates in Rich Results and schema lint, 2) Event includes startDate, organizer & location/url, 3) no duplicate @ids across pages, 4) canonical headers present for SSR variants. Ill add a docs pipeline check that runs the lint on PRs.

olivia: Internal linking rules: 1) pillar -> cluster -> fragment, 2) ensure no cluster page is >3 clicks from root, 3) limit CTAs to 2 per fragment, 4) add jump links for long benchmark narratives and add data-link-weight attr for weighted nav tests. I will create an internal-link diff file for CI.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight checklist running: artifacts seen: KW sheet, schema partial. Still waiting on redirect CSV, internal-link diff, sitemap shards, and tracking wiring. Current status: 2/6.

maria: Monitoring & rollback: add Search Console property check, GA4 funnel for webinar signups, and a 48h redirect-alert to #marketing. rollback plan: keep revert CSV ready with timestamped commit and a controlled edge-cache purge window. If redirect error rate >0.2% for 1h, engage rollback.

eng-release: Note deploy constraints: redirect window Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Olivia please hand off final CSV + revert list 12h prior. Also: we need a small runbook for cache purge (Fastly/Cloudfront) and a holdback for APAC TTL differences.

olivia: will produce CSV and revert commit by Tue 14:00 UTC, plus a step-by-step runbook for cache purge. will run smoke on staging and paste curl outputs here.

anita: Ill run GTM test events and confirm SFDC sandbox mapping by Tue 18:00 UTC. will post webhook logs.

sam: will lock KW sheet and drop meta/title variants in the sheet tonight. will also flag pages to experiment with in the post-webinar email sequence.

jake: pushing schema partial to docs repo and adding a sample include for Next under /docs/seo/includes/event-370246.html. will run the lint and post results.

maria: Condensed preflight (to tick off): 1) KW sheet locked, 2) schema validated and included, 3) internal-link diff applied, 4) redirect CSV smoke-tested + revert ready, 5) sitemap shards submitted, 6) tracking & SFDC wiring confirmed. Tag this thread when each item is done.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight status update: 3/6 (KW sheet, schema partial, internal-link diff present). Still waiting on redirect CSV, sitemap shards, tracking wiring.

maria: Thanks all  focused sprint. Keep updates here. Ping #eng-release and @kevin-salesops when staging passes so we can greenlight the redirect window.
